_about: Master Modeler — unified endpoint registry (single source of truth for `status`/`endpoints`). One entry per REACHABLE thing the control plane can see: cloud model CLIs (claude/grok/gemini), local model servers, and the DGX trainers (probed by ssh-port reach ONLY, no remote exec). Health checks here are READ-ONLY: cli => `--version`, http => GET, tcp => connect. Add an endpoint by appending; no code change needed.
